Visual Walkthrough of the Production Web3 User Interface Across All Examination Lifecycles

Portal User Interface Architecture

This document presents authentic, un-cropped screenshots of the active React/Vite decentralized application connected to the local Ethereum node. The platform provides four specialized role-based views:

1. Genesis Audit Portal (#/setup)

Inspects genesis smart contract deployments, staff registration, collateral staking, and sealed fingerprint commits.

2. Central Administrator Portal (#/admin)

Monitors live countdown, quorum progress dial, fast-forward testing tools, paper selection, and delinquency slashing.

3. Key Custodians Portal (#/staff/1..5)

Allows each of the 5 keyholders to submit confidential entropy seeds, reveal Shamir shares, and safeguard their 1.00 ETH deposit.

4. Exam Centre & Hall Portal (#/college)

Gated by ERC-5192 Soulbound Token #1. Decrypts the official paper in-memory once 3 custodian shares are confirmed on-chain.

System Test Status: 100% Verified

All 89 Hardhat automated test suites passed. The UI demonstrates real-time clock synchronization, anti-tamper rejection, multi-party entropy selection, and automated economic slashing.
